The Landlord may terminate this Agreement at any time by providing 30 days' written notice to the Tenant. Upon such termination, the Tenant shall vacate the Premises within
what_it_means_for_you: Contradictory and unbalanced termination notice: Landlord 30 days vs Tenant 90 days.
risk_reasons: Landlord may terminate by providing 30 days written notice, while tenant must provide 90 days notice in clause 7.
questions_to_ask: Can termination notice periods be made reciprocal (e.g. 30 days for both)?
